headline: Cal-Maine to cull 1.8 million birds in Florida after detecting bird flu outbreak
summary: Cal-Maine Foods said it would cull about 1.8 million birds after detecting a bird flu outbreak at a Florida facility. The company has temporarily halted operations at that site.
why: Cal-Maine is one of the largest US egg producers, so outbreaks at its farms can affect its output and supply of eggs.
original_headline: Cal-Maine sacrificará 1.8 millones de aves en Florida tras detectar brote de gripe aviar
